contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]VS PF AVG ; R/ [FELICITA]S REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Felicitas Rei Publicae issue of 350-351, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing left holding Victory on globe and standard. A in left field. Reverse inscription: [FELICITA]S REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: [--]C. Diameter: 21.7mm, Weight: 4.76gms, die axis: 6
